content_training: All six existing width-16 multimodal_evidence checkpoints remain frozen.
control_training: Six fixed approximate policy-iteration rounds. Each target is forced-first action followed by the previous frozen policy, with complete downstream tariffs. Same public feature dimension and quadratic design as the old ridge. Known immediate fees and no-information SKIP endpoints are exact.
selection: Maximum unweighted exact dev utility among rounds 1..6; ties retain earliest. No fresh graph, loss or return is used. Retain all candidates. Also fit one Qstar control on the same expanded train data and same exact-cost design, using initial-lightweight occupancy weights.
world_seed_formula: 9120000 + model_seed*100 + fresh_config_index; same across families and controllers
forced_prefix_selection: For every fresh config, root and one nonzero-occupancy prefix at each later nonterminal slot, maximizing the sum of lightweight, original_qstar and qpi_selected occupancies; lexicographic history tie-break. Audit all legal forced actions followed by each of those three frozen policies at each selected prefix. These are deterministic coverage samples; all-history Qpi metrics remain separate.
forced_execution: Independent label-conditioned lazy enumeration of raw outcomes through the unchanged original executor. Prefix observations are conditioned using raw likelihoods. Past fees are subtracted when comparing suffix Qpi. Integrate unread futures out without reading them. Preserve every completed world and every case summary, count branch-expansion executions and their full CPU cost.
metrics: actual actor CPU/wall and per-stage CPU
all training and confirmation process CPU/wall
statistical_unit: Three independent pre-existing fitted model seeds; eight fixed task configurations are conditions, not independent trained replicates. Report all seed-level contrasts and their observed range; no significance or population-coverage claim from three seeds.
scientific_gate: Engineering passes require probability/return/regret identity error <2e-10 and zero guard fallbacks. Report empirical changes without turning them into broad superiority. No success threshold is relaxed after results.
scope: Synthetic finite causal content task; fixed checkpoints; three action subset. No RECOVER/CONTINUE, raw-media extension, native production, GPU or energy claim. Expanded training coverage, weighting and exact-cost structure mean qpi-vs-old-ridge is an implementation comparison, not a pure target-only causal experiment.
